headline: Everyone's worried about players being knackered after the break. I checked if it's actually a thing
body: Saw loads of "he'll be tired after the break" comments this week so I had a look at the last 3 seasons. Took everyone who played 60+ mins in the last GW before a break, then checked how many did the same in the first GW back. 11 breaks, 2,120 cases. 77% did, vs 77% in a normal week. So basically no difference. Doesn't tell you anything about a specific injury or a 75% flag, just whether regulars drop out more after a break. Premium sample is small too (46) so take that bit with a pinch of salt. Data's from the vaastav FPL dataset on GitHub, anyone can check it. Let me know if there's anything else you want me to look at.   submitted by   /u/FballLegend [link]   [comments]
